subject: Person-specific brain mapping improved Alzheimer's detection from fMRI
script: From Agewell Brief: Person-specific brain mapping improved Alzheimer's detection from fMRI. A new machine learning method adapts to each person's brain organization, improving Alzheimer's detection and revealing a pattern of network 'dedifferentiation.' Alzheimer's disease is often diagnosed late, when symptoms are already significant. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
